id: title:andyzzhao:shrink export join keys and cap sink buffering

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces memory and CPU consumption for parent-child query rollup joins in S3 export DAG, mitigating OOM or timeout risk on wide probe rows.
review.reason: The change replaces a 36-character query_id with a 64-bit hash (cityHash64) for parent matching and adds parquet row-group settings. This reduces memory and CPU usage for parent-child query rollup joins in S3 export DAG, mitigating OOM or timeout risk on wide probe rows.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that the S3 export DAG is a critical path and that wide probe rows are a significant enough load to warrant this optimization; no runtime metrics or adoption data are supplied.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change group. No other PRs are supplied, so no unrelated-PR uncertainty exists. No tier score is assigned; this is an observation-only pass.
